name: Midodrine
effects: Prodrug — the drug that acts is desglymidodrine, formed by deglycination in many tissues
Raises standing blood pressure by constricting arterioles and veins; no direct cardiac effect
Prescribed for symptomatic orthostatic hypotension, and off-label for vasovagal syncope and hepatorenal syndrome
Desglymidodrine crosses the blood-brain barrier poorly, so it is not centrally stimulating
Supine hypertension is the dose-limiting adverse effect and carries an FDA boxed warning
Midodrine's own half-life is ~25 min; desglymidodrine's is ~3–4 h, and that is what the duration follows

mechanismOfAction.summary: Prodrug of desglymidodrine, a selective peripheral α1-adrenergic agonist — vasoconstriction without central or β-adrenergic action.
mechanismOfAction.description: Oral midodrine is rapidly absorbed and deglycinated to desglymidodrine, which activates α1-adrenoceptors on arteriolar and venous smooth muscle, raising vascular tone and blood pressure. It does not stimulate cardiac β-adrenoceptors, so pulse rate is essentially unchanged, and it penetrates the CNS poorly. Absolute bioavailability measured as desglymidodrine is 93%, unaffected by food; clearance is ~80% active renal secretion. Neither compound is a monoamine-oxidase substrate.
